title: Complexity/erosion measurement rules (trellis-fbc5)
rationale: Scoring (trellis-00d5) and the audit core (trellis-ef85) consume these metrics; the decision table and state rules must stay stable so measurements remain reproducible and hand-calculable (SPEC 5.1-5.2).

title: Duplication method (trellis-5a91): own normalized-token detector, jscpd rejected
rationale: SPEC §5.3 records the decision and evaluation. Own impl = zero new deps, shared-parse leaf-token walk (raw ts.createScanner mis-tokenizes template literals — reproduced), type-1+2 semantics, content-identity groups, per-source-set, budget-guarded incomplete. jscpd 5.2.1 = subprocess-only Rust platform binary, pairs not groups, type-1 default, threaded+timestamped; jscpd 4.3.0 = unmaintained, fails to import under Bun (colors CJS interop), 118 transitive pkgs, type-1 only. Thresholds provisional: 50 tokens AND 3 lines; trellis-e924 calibrates. Expected fixture outputs live in trellis-6e4c.

name: Normalized-token clone detection over the shared parse
description: Duplication analyzer (src/metrics/duplication*.ts, trellis-6e4c): leaf-token walk of the shared ts.SourceFile (iterative stack, EOF dropped), identifiers+ literals each to one placeholder; rolling-hash K=50 windows per source set (never cross-file), pairwise maximal extension verified token-by-token, groups merged by content identity (same length bucket + verified equal), same-file-contained members dropped, fully-contained groups subsumed-dropped. Numerator = union of code-classified lines in member ranges per file; denominator = scope code lines. Budgets (2M tokens, 100M comparisons) trip incomplete via a latching WorkState counter threaded through every comparison loop. Biome cognitive-complexity cap 15 forced splitting extend/detect into small helpers; file-size budget 400 forced a 3-way module split (contract+tokens / detect / groups).

title: Import-graph resolution (trellis-d214): local-files-only, guarded ts.sys host, externals never resolved
rationale: analyzeDependencyGraph (src/metrics/graph-*.ts) resolves via the pinned compiler's ts.resolveModuleName over a guarded ts.sys host that denies node_modules, so results are install-state independent (SPEC §8) and externals are recorded by name, never resolved into. Governing tsconfig = nearest tsconfig.json walking up from the importer; undeclared moduleResolution forced to Bundler; paths-without-baseUrl pinned to the config dir. Workspace packages resolve by manifest name via exports (one condition level import→require→default→types, single-star wildcard, encapsulation) then main/types/index. ImportDeclaration has no isTypeOnly in TS6 — use importClause.isTypeOnly; JSDoc is not in the forEachChild tree, so AST-only extraction inherently resists comment forgery. knip parses docblock import("…") examples as unresolved imports — avoid literal import() call syntax in docblocks.

title: Cycle measurement (trellis-cbde): SCC over per-class subgraphs, stable ids, scored separately
rationale: analyzeCycles (src/metrics/cycles.ts + analyze-cycles.ts) runs iterative Tarjan over two SEPARATE subgraphs (runtime vs type-only local edges) — a/b linked runtime one way and type-only the other is no cycle; CYCLE_POLICY 1.0.0 fixes the scoring definition: classes scored separately (trellis-00d5 weights them). Ids cycle-<n> in (smallest member, class) order; representative path = shortest cycle from smallest member over sorted adjacency (BFS, lexicographic ties); self-edge = size-1 group [p,p]. Metric namespace import-cycle.* (matches contract fixtures); graph incompleteness rolls ALL cycle metrics up incomplete carrying the graph metrics' own reasons + detail.unresolvedEdges (SPEC 3.3). Package views share group ids; module counts stay per-package so the repo union never double-counts cross-package groups. Biome noNonNullAssertion: use ??-fallback / guard-break patterns, never '!'; iterative Tarjan guards every frame/stack index access.

description: analyze-duplication.ts emitted numerator/denominator pairs with denominator 0 for scopes with no code-classified lines (e.g. repos without test files), violating the §6.1 contract (denominator must be positive). Unit tests that only use toMatchObject missed it; only zod validation of emitted metrics caught it.
resolution: Omit the numerator/denominator pair entirely when the denominator can be 0 (fixed in analyze-duplication.ts with trellis-ef85); assert emitted metrics with metricValueSchema.parse in tests.

name: normalized-clones-from-templated-code
description: After identifier/literal normalization, any templated code is a clone: repeated branch blocks (if-chains), generated function families, and periodic structure self-clone regardless of names/values. Eroded test fixtures (tangledFunction patterns) self-clone at any min tokens up to ~120. Clone fixtures must be structurally heterogeneous and sized with collectTokenStream; 105 tokens over 13 lines at CC 10 avoids leaking hotspot findings.

Spike trellis-2d45 found 25 argument-preserving wrappers: 21 anonymous callbacks and four named sites with plausible architectural purposes. Static switch vocabularies found shared legacy disposition tallying, but matching unrelated domains and lookup-table evasion remain confounders.
resolution: Reject raw forwarding count as a slop score; keep probes outside scoring. Validate on held-out maintenance tasks under trellis-f999. Reproduction and paired controls are in docs/research/slop-spike.md.

description: Provider spike trellis-ff55: dependency-cruiser without its optional TypeScript parser returned successful empty graphs; Knip candidate sets changed with entry scripts and canonical filesystem paths. Raw Knip ordering and jscpd date metadata also varied. A tool exit code alone is insufficient evidence of complete deterministic measurement.
resolution: The research harnesses assert input-node coverage and expected positive/negative findings, pin parser/tool/config versions, canonicalize paths and output, and compare a shared source digest. Keep Knip findings advisory under explicit entry/test scope. Follow-up integration contract trellis-06f8; reproduction and measured results in docs/research/provider-spike.md.

name: Carry bounded complexity contributions through native products
description: measureFunctionComplexity retains decision category, exact decision-token range and enclosing-control depth in its existing walk. Samples and depth buckets each cap at 200, with exact omitted totals. FunctionMeasurement carries the evidence through measured analysis products to nativeDetail; assembly and presentation never run a second complexity analyzer. CC includes base one and schema validation reconciles evidence with the finding CC.

name: native-clone-inspection
description: Retain exact clone token offsets beside normalized streams; inspect bounded raw identifier/literal differences after grouping without altering unique-line accounting. Report unexamined comparisons separately from omitted samples and never infer behavioral equivalence.

name: complete-cycle-inspection
description: Attach every observed SCC-internal edge from the existing graph, indexed by edge class and member for linear collection. Sort located edges explicitly to preserve enumeration-order determinism; source graph incompleteness remains visible and old evidence lacks edges rather than implying none.
